flags.name: DSV41_RDMA_TRIM
flags.meaning: C1: the r6 .so launches ar_kernel_r3 (trim) instead of ar_kernel_pl. Needs RDMA_AR_EXT = the r6 .so and RDMA_AR_PUB_V1=1 RDMA_AR_PUB_V2=1 RDMA_AR_HYG_POLL=1 (production defaults). Values: unset/''/0/off/false/no = off, 1/on/true/yes = on, else a startup error (same parser in the .so and rdma_all_reduce.py).

flags.name: DSV41_RDMA_PDL
flags.meaning: C2 (needs DSV41_RDMA_TRIM=1, else a startup error): 1/on/true/yes/in = ar_kernel_r3 launches with PDL (in-edge); trig = also griddepcontrol.launch_dependents after the last flag wait. Never combined with the G26 send-buffer kernels.

flags.name: DSV41_RDMA_TRIM_S1_BYTES
flags.meaning: C1 knob (r3): messages <= this many bytes are staged and published by CTA 0 alone. Decimal 0..2^30, else a startup error.

flags.name: DSV41_RDMA_SENDBUF
flags.meaning: r3 G26 (needs TRIM): registered send-buffer region; BENCH ONLY (no serving producer): never in a serving arm.

flags.name: RDMA_AR_EXT
flags.meaning: existing launcher knob: selects the r6 .so for an arm. With every r6 flag unset the r6 .so runs the live kernels (instruction-identical, gate IDENTITY 39/39) and the live proxy code.
